name: Yamashita Yuuto
source:
A popular male idol.
Yuuto is a person who cares for and takes care of other indiscriminately.
He is very popular among all kinds of people and regardless of hobbies and genders.
Even toward Miyu, Yuuto takes care of her nicely and even became a warm and kind consultant.
